ref: verifier agent prompt: Precision baseline (3-4 shapes), Anchor the first two refinements to perf refinement 1, 2:1 cadence
what: The prompt assumes a non-empty TARGET-SUPPORTED gap and multiple valid shapes. For a single-cell, single-shape op (SUPPORTED==TARGET, validate rejects every other shape) the shape-parametrized precision baseline, the R1/R2 generality anchor and the 2:1 cadence all have nothing to apply to, and the prompt gives no rule for ordering an all-perf queue or for gating a scheme-change perf entry whose headroom depends on an earlier perf entry.
suggest: Add a short single-cell clause: precision baseline varies distribution and seed when only one shape is valid; with no generality gap, the queue is perf-only, ordered by the currently binding ablation term; a perf entry whose headroom depends on a predecessor may close on a recorded no-headroom measurement.
